To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the marine Diesel engine start up systems, which are consisted of ship/s Piston Compressor and its driving electric asynchronous motor, can be modelled by System Dynamics modelling approach.
The marine Diesel engine start up process is a complex dynamic system with non-linear behavior, which can be successfully modeled by the System Dynamics approach, using POWERSIM software.

“The system dynamic simulation model of the marine diesel engine start up system is developed and the system dynamic simulation results of the marine diesel engines start up are presented in POWERSIM software symbolic language”.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the System Dynamic simulation modelling of the Marine Diesel engine start-up system, which it consists of piston compressor, its driving asynchronous motor, i.e., in this case, electric motor and the control system.
the development of the System Dynamic simulation model of the Marine diesel engine start up system.

the development of the system dynamic simulation model of the marine Diesel engine start up process, which is the most important and critical phase of the marine diesel engine operation, and its validation by comparison of the simulation results and the results of the real marine Diesel engine start-up tests, which are conducted on the real ship/s propulsion Diesel engines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the System dynamic simulation model is one of the best and most appropriate modelling methods for the investigation of the complex, technical and organizational system behavior.
the system dynamic models are the most suitable for the simulation of complex technical systems.
the system dynamic model is a continuous discrete model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the system dynamic model, which is presented in the paper, is a very useful tool for investigation of the ship/s piston compressor, i.e. its driving asynchronous motor start-up system behavior dynamics.
we have developed a model that describes the dynamics of a marine diesel engine start up system.

the System Dynamic modelling is a very powerful tool for investigation of complex systems and it has been successfully applied for modelling and simulation of marine Diesel engine start up and other technical systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the System Dynamic Simulation model of marine diesel engine start up system is very useful tool in the process of investigation of its behavior dynamics and it is very helpful in the process of its optimization and improving.
we can model a marine diesel engine start up system in POWERSIM, and that we can use it as a tool for the investigation of its behavior in the time domain.

system dynamic modelling of the complex, nonlinear, natural, technical, and organizational systems is one of the appropriate and successful methods for investigation of behavior dynamics of such systems.
